title: Ghareeb e karbala
body:
Ghareeb e karbala
Haaye, haaye
hussain, hussain
mazloom hussain
Hussain
O the son of Mohammad(pbuh)
O the son of Ali(a.s.)
<<MINI>>
O the love of Fatimah(s.a.)
O the love of Fatimah(s.a.)
Ya ghareeb e karbala(O the lonely one of Karbala)..(5)
<<DIVIDER>>
Savior of humanity
Axis of equality
Source of spirituality
Symbol of purity
O hussain you are the will of God
Strike on brutality
<<MINI>>
Ya ghareeb e karbala(O the lonely one of Karbala)..(5)
<<DIVIDER>>
O the love of Almighty
Victim of brutality To revive morality
sacrificed your family
By the side of flowing river..(2)
O Hussain you died thirsty
<<MINI>>
Ya ghareeb e karbala(O the lonely one of Karbala)..(5)
<<DIVIDER>>
Your blood spilled in opression
your kids faced aggression
O Hussain you stood for love
O Hussain you stood for peace
O Hussain you spread justice
O the ship of salvation
<<MINI>>
Ya ghareeb e karbala(O the lonely one of Karbala)..(5)
<<DIVIDER>>
Ya hussain, ya hussain Mazloom..
